en.headline: Officials step up rodent control at Tsim Sha Tsui Cultural Centre after night videos
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said it received five complaints in two weeks and placed traps after footage showed groups of rats on the viewing platform.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said it had received five rodent complaints in the past two weeks concerning the Hong Kong Cultural Centre plaza and viewing platform in Tsim Sha Tsui. Videos circulating on social media had shown groups of rats active at night on the viewing platform.

The department said it arranged a pest-control contractor on 2 November to place traps and bait boxes, clear hiding spots and pathways, and increase night-time inspections and cleaning. On Monday morning it conducted a joint inspection with the contractor and the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department to investigate sources and strengthen measures, including replacing bait, trimming vegetation and sealing gaps.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said its district officers had earlier noted the problem and conducted multiple inspections, providing targeted advice to venue managers. It stressed that managing departments must take the initiative in rodent control and that measures should not wait until rats are spotted.

The Cultural Centre area is a popular tourist spot where visitors often bring their own food, which the Leisure and Cultural Services Department said could attract rodents seeking food. Both departments said they would continue monitoring and follow-up work.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀文化中心夜間現鼠群 康文署加強滅鼠
zh.dek: 康文署表示過去兩周接獲五宗投訴，並在網上影片顯示觀景台有鼠群後放置捕鼠器。
body: 康樂及文化事務署表示，過去兩周就尖沙咀香港文化中心廣場及觀景台一帶接獲五宗鼠患投訴。網上社交媒體流傳影片顯示夜間觀景台有多隻老鼠活動。
署方稱已於十一月二日安排滅鼠承辦商在場地放置捕鼠器及鼠藥餌盒、清除藏匿點及通道，並增加夜間巡視及清潔。周一早上再聯同承辦商及食物環境衛生署到場聯合視察，以偵查源頭及加強防治，包括更換補充鼠餌、修剪植物及填補裂縫。
食環署表示分區人員早前已留意到有關情況，並多次主動進入範圍巡查，向場地管理人員提供針對性建議。署方強調管理部門必須主動採取防鼠措施，不應等到發現老鼠才處理。
文化中心一帶是旅遊熱點，不少遊人自備食物休憩，康文署指這可能吸引老鼠覜食。兩署表示會繼續監察及跟進防治工作。
